nodes.name: DESIGN_POV.md
nodes.summary: Strategic design point-of-view notes for the Waggle app covering five themes: memory trust, cold-start inversion, voice and lexicon, inference billing model, and the morning briefing as a user ritual.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design handoff document for the Waggle app and landing site 'warm Hive' refactor, covering information architecture, 18 screens, design tokens (colors, typography, radius/shadow), cross-cutting behaviors, and tech mapping to the existing monorepo.

nodes.name: SCREENS.md
nodes.summary: Per-screen specifications for all 18 screens in the Waggle app UI redesign, including Home/Cockpit, Chat, Workspace, Marketplace, Onboarding, Settings, Auth (Clerk), Billing (Stripe), and more, with ship-variation decisions for each screen.
